End Demonstration runs "replace_wizard demo, finish", swapping the active demo wizard in place.
The Mutagenesis submenu leaf "Nucleic Acids" dispatches "wizard nucmutagenesis".
Every local wizard returns get_panel()==[], so the panel renders the "prompt-only wizard — no panel rows" fallback.
Pushing two wizards makes depth>1, so the panel head renders the stack-depth badge (WizardPanel §depth).
get_prompt() lines render through a portal into .shell__viewport as the green wizard prompt overlay.
With depth==0 the panel returns null and the prompt (promptMode 0/empty) is suppressed.
The Dismiss button (shown only while active) calls wizards.dismiss → pops the top wizard; a single-wizard stack empties and the panel disappears.
